caption: Member profile: membership
Freeze: the days and the reason
Frozen: access stops, the days are given back
Upgrade: price and credit note before anything is paid
Upgrade made: GST credit note and invoice
Invoices, payments and the credit note
Cancel: effective date and what the member may be owed
Canceled: nothing refunded, Request refund
Request refund: goes to finance
Collect a part payment
Part payment recorded: receipt, balance still due
Bookings: a session on a trainer’s leave
Move the session: same trainer or another
Bookings: the day by trainer
Finance: refund queue with what approving does
Approve: audited, can’t be undone
Refund approved and listed as decided
Reconciliation: flagged items and a repeated event
Accept a flagged item with a note
Invoices and payments: billed and collected apart
Exports: role-scoped CSV
Day close: cash short, a note is needed
Day closed with a variance: the day is locked
